content:
tam: FYI I hit a flaky anchor issue while cleaning up examples. Headings that end with a code span like `# Reconnect to pool ` (note trailing space inside backticks) produce two different slugs depending on slugifier ordering. Old links are 404ing.

jo: Oof. Repro: run `yarn build:docusaurus` then `node scripts/fragments.js` to list generated ids. I saw `reconnect-to-pool` vs `reconnect-to-pool-` on the same page.

frank: I opened PR 5012 to normalize heading tokens before slugify: trim outer whitespace, collapse internal whitespace, and treat backtick spans as atomic tokens. But it regressed one contributor's manual `<a id=>` anchors.

leah: Can we make the normalization opt-in behind a config flag? Roll it on staging first, run full linkcheck, then flip in prod. Also add a small collector that emits redirects for historical variants.

linkbot: linkcheck: docs/operations/pool-management.md  5 broken fragments (branch/5012). Report: https://ci.redwood-inference.local/links/5012

jo: I sketched `tools/slug_normalizer.py --emit-redirects` that scans git history and outputs a redirects snippet. If the collector finds < 100 variants we'll emit redirects.json; otherwise prefer source edits.

frank: Added unit tests for code span and trailing-space cases. Also added a safe-mapping for manual HTML ids: plugin will respect explicit `<a id>` values and won't rewrite them, but will log them so authors can opt into the normalization.

leah: QA note: some macOS contributors' files are NFC vs NFD; run the collector on both mac and linux runners to be safe.

ci-bot: build: branch/pr/5012  staging linkcheck pending. 0/1 full-run done.

jo: Quick mitigation: I've opened a tiny redirects PR that maps the most common legacy slugs for the public docs. PR 5013 includes 14 entries found by running the collector on main.

tam: Good. After 5012 lands with flag off by default, we'll enable it on staging, run `yarn linkcheck:full`, and if green merge the redirects PR and flip the flag in prod during the quiet window.

frank: One gotcha: punctuation inside code spans (e.g., `cleanup()`) gets stripped differently. I added a heuristic: preserve alphanumerics and common paren tokens inside backticks; anything else collapses to hyphen.

leah: Please add a short changelog blurb about anchor normalization and link to the redirects file so support can respond to 404 tickets quickly.

linkbot: action: tag @support to monitor anchor-related tickets for 72h post-deploy.

jo: PR links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 (normalizer WIP), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5013 (redirects snippet). Please review.

tam: Thanks team. Once staging passes I'll merge in sequence: 5012 -> 5013 -> enable flag. Keep the normalization toggle for at least one release cycle.
